prompt.role: You are an expert healthcare data analyst extracting prior authorization (PA) duration values from insurance policy documents.
prompt.task:
Extract the authorization duration values for {brand} from the PA policy document below. Focus on plaque psoriasis (PsO) only.
Return ONLY a JSON object with exactly 2 keys. No explanation, no preamble, no markdown formatting.
prompt.scope:
INDICATION SCOPE: Plaque psoriasis (PsO) only. If the policy specifies different durations for different indications, extract ONLY the plaque psoriasis duration. If a duration applies to ALL indications universally, use that value.
BRAND SCOPE: Durations for {brand} ({generics_list}) or durations that apply universally to all drugs in the policy.

business_rules.rule:
initial_auth_duration: The duration of the FIRST (initial) authorization period. This is how long the drug is approved before the patient must seek renewal.
Common phrasings: "Initial Approval: up to N months", "authorized for N months", "Length of Approval: N months (initial)", "coverage for up to N months".
Output format: "N Months" — capitalize Months, use integer (e.g., "3 Months", "6 Months", "12 Months").
If the policy does not specify an initial duration: "NA". "Unspecified" is NOT a valid output — use "NA".

reauth_duration: The duration of each RENEWAL (reauthorization) period after the initial approval.
Common phrasings: "Reauthorization Approval: up to N months", "renewal period of N months", "continuation approval for N months", "Length of Approval: N months (renewal/continuation)".
Output format: "N Months" — capitalize Months, use integer.
If the policy requires reauthorization but does not state the duration: "NA". If the policy does not require reauthorization at all: "NA". "Unspecified" is NOT a valid output — use "NA".

Many policies state the same duration for initial and reauth, or state only one. Extract what is explicitly stated. Do not assume reauth duration equals initial duration unless the policy explicitly says so.

"NA" covers these cases: - The duration is not mentioned anywhere in the policy - The policy uses language like "ongoing", "until clinical failure", "no specified duration" - The duration section exists but does not give a numeric value
Do NOT output a duration you are uncertain about. When in doubt: "NA".

Duration values appear under MANY different label formats across payers. Recognise ALL of the following as valid duration statements:
INITIAL duration labels: - "Initial Approval: up to N months" (Aetna Better Health) - "Authorization of N months may be granted" (Aetna / Wellmark — see note below) - "Initial PA requests may be approved for up to N days" (ForwardHealth — convert days) - "Approve for N months if patient meets ALL of..." (WHA / 215824 format) - "Coverage Duration: Initial: N months" (WellSense table-format policies) - "Approval Duration: N Months" (Aetna BRM Addendum) - "Length of Approval: N Month(s)" (BCBS/Anthem module format)
REAUTH duration labels: - "Renewal Approval: up to N months" - "Renewal PA requests may be approved for up to N days" (ForwardHealth) - "Reauthorization Approval: up to N months" - "Coverage Duration: Reauthorization: N months" (WellSense) - "Approve for 1 year" (convert to 12 Months) - "Length of Approval: N Month(s)" when the surrounding section is a renewal or continuation section
NOTE — "Authorization of N months may be granted" ambiguity: Aetna and Wellmark use this SAME phrase for both initial criteria AND continuation criteria. Disambiguate by section context: - First occurrence (under "Coverage Criteria" / "Initial Criteria") = initial_auth_duration - Occurrence under "Continuation of Therapy" or "Reauthorization" section = reauth_duration
DAY CONVERSION: When duration is stated in days, divide by 30.4 and round to nearest integer month. Key values: 183 days = 6 Months, 365 days = 12 Months.

example.policy_excerpt: Duration of Approval: Initial Approval: up to 3 months Reauthorization Approval: up to 12 months
Length of Approval: 12 months for all indications. Plaque psoriasis: 12 months (initial and renewal).

example.description: Only initial stated, no renewal info
